entries.name: TYIM
entries.note: The bundle's resources show TYIM is the Traditional Chinese Cantonese input method. jyutping.rs is the Jyutping composer (source bifrost.inputmethod.TYIM.Jyutping, language yue-Hant): letters build syllables checked against the Jyutping initials and finals, a tone digit 1-6 ends a syllable, several syllables make a word, space picks the first candidate and a digit after the tone picks another. Built in this round: the reading table grew from about seventy to a few hundred everyday readings (pronouns, particles, family, school, time, travel, food, greetings and common words), checked for well-formed syllables and no duplicate readings (tests jyutping::tests). Not built: a full dictionary (rarer readings have no candidate) and the Cantonese pinyin layout.
entries.ready_note: The Jyutping composer is a built-in input method source; the checks run its syllable rules, the table's well-formedness and uniqueness, word candidates, toneless candidate order and the controller typing a greeting into a field.

entries.name: TrackpadIM
entries.note: n/a: the input method that recognises Chinese characters drawn on a trackpad (the bundle's strings are zh-Hans, zh-Hant and yue-Hant) with trained handwriting-recognition models, which are Apple ML model packs BifrOSt does not carry or mirror. BifrOSt has the stroke layout and a single-stroke glyph recogniser for Latin letters and digits (ui/src/handwriting.rs, glyph_recognizer.rs) and types Chinese through the pinyin, zhuyin and Jyutping composers.

entries.name: VietnameseIM
entries.note: Pure-Rust Telex and VNI composers: marks, bar, tones with modern placement, tone removal, backspace replay. No Simple Telex or VIQR, no syllable validation. Host tests only; needs a Midget check and wiring in kb_input.rs. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
